findings: target/tests/test_ops.py test_maximum asserts `maximum(a, b) == maximum(a, b)`, a tautology that ignores the `want` parameter. It can never fail, so the maximum helper is effectively untested, which weakens test coverage. It should assert `== want`.
The implementations in target/src/calc/__init__.py are correct. The tests for multiply, power, modulo and floor_divide are meaningful and include zero or negative cases.
